events.subtitle: Rasmus Faber presents anime standards as a live jazz ensemble
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Platina Jazz from November 29 through December 2, 2026. November 29 has 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets; November 30 through December 2 have 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets. The official event page lists an 11-person ensemble led by Rasmus Faber, with Niklas Gabrielsson and Emily McEwan on vocals, performing the project's jazz arrangements of Japanese anime songs.

en.why_it_matters: The reason this belongs is not simply that anime themes are being played as jazz. Rasmus Faber has spent years treating that repertoire as material for real arranging, horn writing, vocal interpretation and swing; this Tokyo return brings the project back as an 11-person ensemble with dual vocals. It is a useful piece of the Japan thread because it shows Japanese popular-memory repertoire being reworked through a Scandinavian jazz vocabulary rather than presented as novelty crossover.
en.trip_verdict: Worth knowing about and catching if one of the four nights falls open in Tokyo, especially if the anime-to-jazz crossover itself is part of the listening thread. I would not displace a rarer master, one-off lineup or historically specific date for it.

es.why_it_matters: Entra no simplemente porque convierta temas de anime en jazz. Rasmus Faber lleva años tratando ese repertorio como material real de arreglo, escritura para metales, interpretación vocal y swing; este regreso a Tokio vuelve a presentar el proyecto como un ensamble de once músicos con dos voces. Dentro del hilo Japón sirve porque muestra memoria popular japonesa releída desde un vocabulario jazzístico escandinavo y no como simple novedad crossover.
es.trip_verdict: Vale tenerlo presente y entrarle si una de las cuatro noches queda libre en Tokio, sobre todo si el cruce anime-jazz forma parte de lo que quieres escuchar. No movería por esto una fecha más rara de un maestro, una formación de una sola noche o un contexto histórico más específico.
